newsitem.title: TURKEY: Explosion rips through Istanbul cosmetic factory.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rips through Istanbul cosmetic factory.

text.p: Blasts tore through a liquid gas tank at a cosmetic factory in the Istanbul district of Pendik on Tuesday, but there were no immediate reports of deaths or injuries, security officials said.
"Efforts to put out the fire are continuing. There is no immediate information on dead or injured. We cannot get close to the area," a local security official told Reuters by telephone.
Local NTV said there were no workers inside the plant at the time of the blast.
Local officials said a 10-tonne liquid gas tank exploded at the Matsan cosmetic factory starting the fire and setting off a series of smaller blasts and spreading the flames.

Television pictures showed plumes of black smoke rising into the sky and fire crews from surrounding districts of the city rushing to the scene, an industrial district on the outskirts of Istanbul's Asian shore.
